How boards are built

Unique Research ranks each metric for October across continuous tracking of thousands of AI companies and ~10k products. Stickiness = per-user visit duration. Growth = MoM change. Companion Company and APP October boards published separately; Oct global traffic narrative report also available.

Research statement (abridged)

WEB/APP on PC/tablet/phone only — not plugins, desktop software, mini-programs, Discord, local open-source. Filter: >10k monthly visits. Mixed sources + Unique Research labeling. Geography: Overseas / Domestic / Outbound as in Company boards. Cite Unique Research; not investment advice.

— END —
